reviewBasis.notice: Review applies only to these exact asset, avatar and retarget-code hashes. Any change requires rechecking the affected rendered candidate. Technical parsing, file integrity and source labels do not establish human ASL approval or grammatical translation.

clips.candidateMeaning: Candidate HELP mapping from the source filename; assistance/help variant is unverified; direction and participant agreement are not inferred.
clips.modifications: Motion-only extraction: meshes, materials, images and textures removed; rig transforms, inverse-bind metadata and all original source keyframes retained. Runtime calibration uses the actual first animated anatomical pose, per-palm and finger-axis frames, proportional arm IK and source near-contact landmark-pair constraints on separately licensed Aarav. Detected terminal actor-axis reset keys and outlying joint-4 nodes are excluded from playback sampling; original raw tracks remain intact.
remainingTechnicalLimitations: Landmark contact is a skeletal proxy; skin contact and handshape require visual and fluent-signer review.
Target hand sizes and torso proportions differ; chest/wrist locations can shift by several centimetres.
